name: lovekept
description: Put an obituary online as a memorial page family can visit and share, with photos and service details, make a page for a funeral or celebration of life, estimate funeral and cremation costs, find funeral homes and funeral assistance, start a memorial fundraiser, and send sympathy flowers with Lovekept.

interface.longDescription:
Lovekept puts an obituary online as a memorial page that family and friends can visit, share, and reply to. It is for families after a death: the page holds the obituary, photos, and the funeral, visitation, celebration of life, or livestream details, with RSVPs and a guestbook. ChatGPT can help write the obituary from the details the family gives, or start from one the family already has, such as the funeral home's. You see a preview of the page first. To save it, you sign in to Lovekept; then you can add the photos you share in the chat, publish the page, invite up to four family members to help edit, and get a message with the link to send by text, email, WhatsApp, or Facebook. Saved memorials are kept in your Lovekept account, and you view and manage them on lovekept.co.

Share a funeral or celebration of life. Add a service to a memorial page, or make a page for a funeral, memorial service, or celebration of life on its own when there is no memorial. Guests see the details and reply on that page. When the date, time, or place changes, or the service is cancelled, Lovekept emails the guests who replied or asked for updates.

Understand costs and help paying. Estimate what a cremation or funeral costs in a US state or ZIP code, item by item, see funeral homes nearby and what homes in the area typically charge from their published price lists, and find programs that may help pay, such as Social Security, VA, and state burial assistance. These are estimates, not quotes, and prices and program rules change, so confirm with the funeral home or the program. These need no sign-in.

Send sympathy flowers. Browse arrangements with photos, prices, and delivery dates for a funeral home, church, or home, then complete the order and payment on lovekept.co. Delivery is within the United States.

Start a memorial fundraiser. ChatGPT drafts the title, story, and goal, and you start the fundraiser yourself from the card after reading the Fundraising Terms. Donations are made on the memorial page on lovekept.co, and payouts are set up there. Fundraisers are for organizers in the United States.

See who has visited. Check views, guestbook messages, RSVPs, and fundraiser progress for a memorial.

Saving, publishing, and anything tied to your account use your Lovekept sign-in. Lovekept receives what you ask it to look up or save, your account email from sign-in, and the approximate location ChatGPT shares with plugins. Payments, donations, and payouts are handled on lovekept.co rather than in ChatGPT. Memorials and gatherings are removed on lovekept.co.
capabilities: Pages for funerals and celebrations of life
defaultPrompt: Help me write my mom's obituary and put it online as a page our family can share.
Put my dad's obituary from the funeral home online as a memorial page.
Estimate what a funeral or cremation costs in my ZIP code.

positive.description: Writing an obituary and putting it online as a memorial page with photos. The user shares facts about their mother and attaches two photos to the same message that asks to save the memorial and add them. ChatGPT writes the obituary from those facts only and shows the draft, previews it as a memorial page, saves it, adds the photos, and publishes it after the user confirms.
positive.prompt: My mom, Eleanor Ruth Hayes, passed away on September 28 in Columbus, Ohio. She was born March 3, 1946, in Dayton. She taught second grade for 31 years, sang in the church choir, and grew roses. She leaves my dad, Robert, my brother Michael, me (Laura), and five grandchildren. Please write her obituary, save it to my Lovekept account as a memorial page the family can share, and add these two photos to it. I would like to see it before it goes public.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT writes the obituary only from the facts given, inventing nothing, and shows the draft. preview_memorial shows a memorial card with her name, dates, place, and obituary, with no account change. Because this message asks to save it, create_memorial saves the memorial unpublished (after the user connects Lovekept if not yet connected), and add_photos adds the two photos attached to this same message to its gallery. If the save happens in a later message instead, ChatGPT asks the user to attach the photos again in that message, because photos can only be read from the message they are attached to. publish_memorial runs only after the user confirms in a later message. The confirmation card shows the public lovekept.co link and says the memorial can be managed at lovekept.co/dashboard.

positive.description: Adding a funeral service to an existing memorial and getting a message to share. Uses the sample memorial for Ruth Ann Lindgren in the test account.
positive.prompt: Ruth's funeral will be this Saturday at 10:30 in the morning at First Lutheran Church, 600 Elm Avenue, Story City, Iowa. Can you add it to her memorial and write a short message I can text to family and friends?
positive.expected_behavior: list_my_memorials finds Ruth Ann Lindgren's memorial. add_service adds a funeral service with the date, 10:30 AM start, church name and address, and a time zone, and confirms it now shows on the memorial. get_share_message returns the memorial link and a ready-to-send text that mentions the service. ChatGPT shows the message for the user to copy; nothing is sent on the user's behalf.

positive.description: Making a page for a celebration of life when the family has no memorial. The gathering gets its own page on lovekept.co where guests reply; no memorial is created. Saving needs sign-in with the test account.
positive.prompt: My grandma, Dorothy Mae Keller, died last week. We're holding a celebration of life for her this Saturday at 2 pm at the Oak Park Pavilion, 100 Euclid Avenue, Oak Park, Illinois 60302. We don't have a memorial page for her. Can you make an invitation page where people can say if they're coming?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT reads the details back (a celebration of life for Dorothy Mae Keller, this Saturday's date, 2:00 PM, Oak Park Pavilion and its address) and asks the user to confirm. After the user connects Lovekept if not yet connected and confirms, create_gathering creates the celebration of life with no memorial and returns the gathering's own lovekept.co link, where guests reply. ChatGPT gives the user that link. It does not create a memorial, write an obituary, or offer other Lovekept services.

positive.description: Estimating cremation costs, then starting a funeral-costs fundraiser through the fundraiser card. Run after the first test case, on Eleanor Ruth Hayes's memorial. The estimate needs no account; the fundraiser is only created when the user taps the button in the card.
positive.prompt: We're planning a cremation with a memorial service for Mom in Columbus, Ohio, ZIP 43215. About how much should we expect, and can we start a fundraiser on her memorial to help cover it? I live in Ohio, in the US.
positive.expected_behavior: estimate_cremation_cost shows a cost card for a cremation with a memorial service near Columbus: the total, the typical range, each item, Ohio notes, sources, and a note that it is an estimate, not a quote, to confirm with the funeral home. ChatGPT repeats that caution and does not present the figure as a quote. For the fundraiser, list_my_memorials finds Mom's memorial and prepare_fundraiser shows a fundraiser card with the funeral costs purpose, the estimate as the goal, a drafted title and story, a link to the Fundraising Terms, and an "I agree, start fundraiser" button. Nothing is created until the user taps it, which calls create_fundraiser from the card. No donation is taken and no money moves in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Sending sympathy flowers to a funeral. Works for any funeral; here it uses the service on the sample memorial. Checkout and payment happen on lovekept.co.
positive.prompt: I'd like to send sympathy flowers to Ruth Lindgren's funeral on Saturday at First Lutheran Church, 600 Elm Avenue, Story City, Iowa 50248. The church's phone is 515-555-0142. Something around $100, please.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says flowers deliver within the United States, then show_sympathy_flowers shows a carousel of arrangements with photos, names, prices near $100, and available delivery dates. After the user picks one and ChatGPT helps word the card message, start_flower_order returns a Continue to Lovekept checkout link with the arrangement, delivery date, church address, and card message filled in. Payment is entered only on lovekept.co; nothing is charged in ChatGPT.

negative.description: Buying trees or a memorial upgrade. Lovekept does not sell trees, plans, or upgrades in ChatGPT and has no tool that does, so the plugin should not act on this.
negative.prompt: Can you plant ten trees in Ruth's memory and upgrade her memorial so it stays online forever?
negative.expected_behavior: No Lovekept tool is called to buy anything. ChatGPT explains that these cannot be purchased in this chat and offers what it can help with, such as sharing the memorial or adding service details.

negative.description: Donating or moving money in chat. There is no tool that takes a payment or moves money inside ChatGPT. Donors give on the memorial page on lovekept.co, and organizers manage payouts on lovekept.co.
negative.prompt: Please donate $50 to Ruth's fundraiser from my card, and send the money raised so far to my bank account.
negative.expected_behavior: No Lovekept tool charges a card or transfers money. ChatGPT explains that donations are made on the memorial page on lovekept.co and that payouts are set up and managed by the organizer on lovekept.co.

negative.description: Grief with no request. The user shares a loss but asks for nothing Lovekept does, so the plugin should not act and should not offer its services.
negative.prompt: I'm really struggling since my mom died last month. Some days I can't get out of bed.
negative.expected_behavior: No Lovekept tool is called and Lovekept is not offered. ChatGPT responds with care on its own and, if the user seems at risk, points to crisis support.

review.commerce_description: Lovekept sells physical sympathy flower arrangements, delivered by local florists within the United States. ChatGPT shows arrangements and prices, then hands the order to checkout on lovekept.co, where the buyer enters payment. Nothing is purchased inside ChatGPT. The app sells no digital goods, subscriptions, or upgrades, and it never takes donations or moves money in chat.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1: the single skill becomes one skill per task, each with the Lovekept tools it uses: write an obituary, put an obituary online and look after the memorial page, funeral and service details, memorial fundraiser, sympathy flowers, and funeral costs and help, plus a getting-started skill that runs after install. A new tool, create_gathering, makes a page for a funeral, memorial service, or celebration of life when there is no memorial, where guests reply; update_service and cancel_service also work for those gatherings. Starter prompts and review cases updated to match.
